_doc: The pinned art pack (ADR 0002, docs/adr/0002-pinned-art-pack.md): which release the game uses and where it is installed. bash scripts/art_pack.sh fetch reads the release block; ArtPack (game/scripts/core/art/art_pack.gd) reads install_dir and the rest. Bump the pack by changing the release block and the checksum manifest together (CONTRIBUTING.md, Art pack releases).

provenance.made_by: Jarvis, the project owner's ChatGPT agent
provenance.made_with: Blender 4.3.2, procedurally (the generators stay with Jarvis; a not-run copy ships under reference/)
provenance.delivered: 2026-10-13, as nine ZIPs attached to #59 (pack v1)
provenance.packaged_by: tools/art_pack/build_release.py (PACKAGING.json in the asset records the source ZIPs' SHA-256)

packaging_changes.why: bed.glb and Bed.glb differ only in case and collide on case-insensitive file systems; the catalog maps Bed to Bed.glb. Every JSON naming bed.glb was updated (asset_index.json, docs/glb_structural_audit.json, environment/manifest.json, environment/manifest_complete.json, godot_validation.json, validation.json). #61 removes the clash upstream in v1.1, which then needs only a version bump.
